message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on tow-behind mowing/sweeping machines. The candidates are 8433.40 (mowers, including cutter bars for tractor mounting) and 8479.89 (other machines), with 8433.11 and 8433.19 also possible. Sweepers for lawns fall under 8479.89 or 8705.

The principal function is mowing, which points to heading 8433, specifically "Mowers for lawns, parks or sports grounds." The machines have no independent drive, so they are not self-propelled, and the cutting is by rotary blades. Under 8433.11 the mowers are powered, with a horizontal cutting device, and 8433.19 covers the others, with 8433.19.90 as the "other" subheading. Because the machine is a trailed (tow-behind) unit with no motor of its own that provides the cutting, 8433.19 is the likely fit. Under 8433.20 are the "other mowers, including cutter bars for tractor mounting," and tow-behind mowers typically fall there: 8433.20.10 is for "mowers, including cutter bars for tractor mounting," with 8433.20.1000 covering the "Mowers." 

The subheading structure is 8433.20 "Other mowers, including cutter bars for tractor mounting," with the statistical suffix 8433.20.5090 for "Other." I'll go with 8433.20.5090 (currently "Other mowers... Other").
